name: Herpes
overview: Scripture reveals that God, in His holiness and justice, warns of diseases and pestilences as consequences for disobedience, as seen in Deuteronomy 28:21. Yet, He also promises healing and protection to those who faithfully obey His commandments, according to Exodus 15:26. Furthermore, God's moral standards, including those governing sexual behavior, are clearly defined, with severe consequences for transgressions as stated in Leviticus 20:13. Together, these verses emphasize the importance of obedience to God’s statutes for physical and spiritual well-being.
